before.name: Jonathan Caravello
before.description: Jonathan Caravello was arrested on July 10, 2025 while protesting a federal immigration raid at Glass House Farms in Camarillo, California. Prosecutors alleged that he threw a tear-gas canister toward agents; witnesses said he was moving it away from a wheelchair. A judge ordered his release on July 14, and a federal jury acquitted him in April 2026.
